title: New York Senate Bill S.6953-B (2025-2026 Regular Sessions), signed as Chapter 699 of the Laws of 2025: the RAISE Act as first enacted (General Business Law Article 44-B, §§ 1420-1425)
role_note: The bill text from the Assembly's own site, print B: the Actions record 'PRINT NUMBER 6953B' 06/09/2025, 'PASSED SENATE' and 'passed assembly' 06/12/2025 (substituted for A6453-B), 'DELIVERED TO GOVERNOR' 12/09/2025 and 'SIGNED CHAP.699' and 'APPROVAL MEMO.76' 12/19/2025. Used only to show what Chapter 96 changed; its Article 44-B was repealed and replaced by Chapter 96 section 2, and its effective date moved to 2027-01-01 by Chapter 96 section 3 (whether it was briefly in force between its original 90th day and 2026-03-27 is not decided; NOTES.md F14). The approval memo was not fetched.
access_note: www.nysenate.gov answered HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge page ('Just a moment...') to robots.txt at about 2026-10-24T02:43Z; legislation.nysenate.gov did not answer within 20 seconds (connection timed out); neither was used, and no API key was registered or used. nyassembly.gov robots.txt (read 2026-10-24) reads, in full: 'User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: /'; it does not address this fetcher's User-Agent. Fewer than 15 requests in all were made to nyassembly.gov, with no 403, 429 or challenge.
official_status: unofficial plain-text conversion by Legalese Commons of the bill text printed on the New York State Assembly's own bill-search page; not the Laws of New York as published, and not a consolidated text of the General Business Law (none could be fetched)

in_force: Section 3 as enacted: 'on the ninetieth day after it shall have become a law'; amended by L. 2026, ch. 96, § 3 to 'January 1, 2027'. Article 44-B as enacted here was repealed by L. 2026, ch. 96, § 2, effective on the same date.
converter: page bytes decoded as Latin-1 (the page declares utf-8 but its section signs are single A7 bytes); script, style and HTML tags removed; entities unescaped; only the lines between the '<bill> Text:' marker and the next 'Go to top' kept; blank lines dropped; trailing spaces removed; a four-line header added. Underscoring (new matter) is lost. The bill's own page numbers and line numbers are kept, so each line starts with the bill's line number. In the page, the exponent of 10^26 is printed as the byte A7, which decodes to a section sign: '10§26'. (scratchpad script h2t.py; tools are kept outside commons)
